mapper.select: SELECT pb.batch_no as batchNo, pb.batch_seq as batchSeq, bb.material_code as materialCode, bb.material_name as materialName, bb.planned_qty as bomPlannedQty, a.actual_qty as actualQty, a.operator_name as operatorName, a.complete_time as completeTime, ROUND(IFNULL(a.actual_qty, 0) - bb.planned_qty, 4) as diffQty FROM mis_production_batch_bom bb INNER JOIN mis_production_batch pb ON pb.id = bb.batch_id LEFT JOIN mis_production_batch_material_actual a ON a.batch_bom_id = bb.id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE bb.material_id = #{materialId} AND pb.order_id = #{orderId} AND bb.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pb.batch_seq, a.complete_time
